summary: This filing is a Form 8-K reporting a registered direct offering by New Horizon Aircraft Ltd. The company sold 9,254,889 Class A ordinary shares at $2.15 per share for gross proceeds of ~$19.9 million to institutional investors. The offering is a standard equity capital raise, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC business combination, or forced management change. It is a routine definitive agreement entry under Item 1.01. The filing includes a customary 45-day lockup on future issuance. Net proceeds will fund aircraft program development and working capital. The expected closing date is May 8, 2026.
